summary: Studio Art Engine will undergo an app-wide UI/UX optimization pass focused strictly on visual and interaction refinements (spacing, alignment, typography/hierarchy, responsive layout, navigation flow polish, immediate feedback, and a unified Apple HIG–style motion system), while preserving the existing section/page layout structures; this pass may include a deeper Apple-style design direction (e.g., translucency, cards, depth, motion system rewrite) but excludes internal logic refactors and known-issue fixes.

existing_features.title: Multi-project dashboard (create/open/edit/delete)
existing_features.description: Create new projects (name, symbol, blockchain, collection size, pixel-art mode), open projects into the editor, edit project fields via a settings modal, and delete projects with a confirmation prompt.

existing_features.title: In-app view navigation with responsive header + mobile menu
existing_features.description: Header provides navigation between Workshop, Rarity, Rules, Preview, Forge, Vault, and Settings for the active project; includes a mobile menu and a back-to-projects action.

existing_features.title: Project domain model with settings defaults, validation, sanitization, and migrations
existing_features.description: Defines typed project entities (layers/traits/rules/custom tokens/generated NFTs) and project settings; validates and sanitizes loaded data, migrates legacy rule shape and legacy outputWidth/outputHeight to outputSize.

existing_features.title: Client-side persistence via debounced atomic localStorage snapshot
existing_features.description: Persists all projects to a single canonical localStorage key using debounced overwrite (last-write-wins), validates before save, warns near quota, and cleans up legacy temp/backup storage artifacts.

existing_features.title: Autosave status indicator in header
existing_features.description: Displays a small non-intrusive “Saving…” and “Saved” indicator; idle and failed states are not shown visually.

existing_features.title: Global destructive-action confirmation dialog (promise-based)
existing_features.description: Centralized confirmation dialog using a Zustand store exposing confirm() that resolves a Promise<boolean>, used for destructive actions like deleting projects.

existing_features.title: Workshop: layer management (add/select/rename/delete/reorder)
existing_features.description: Create layers, select a layer to edit, inline-rename layers, delete layers, and reorder layers via drag-and-drop.

existing_features.title: Workshop: per-layer compositing controls (opacity + blend mode)
existing_features.description: Configure each layer’s opacity (0–100) and blend mode (normal/multiply/overlay) used by canvas compositing (Preview/Forge) and intended for generation compositing.

existing_features.title: Workshop: trait asset management (upload/preview/rename/delete)
existing_features.description: Upload multiple image traits per layer (stored as data URLs), auto-name from filenames, show thumbnails, inline-rename traits, and delete traits with toast feedback and file-read error handling.

existing_features.title: Rule reference hygiene on layer/trait deletion
existing_features.description: When deleting layers or traits, rules are updated to remove invalid references; rules with deleted primaries or empty incompatible sets are removed.

existing_features.title: Matching rules system (exclude/force) with CRUD UI
existing_features.description: Create, edit, duplicate, and delete rules of type exclude/force; modal UI supports selecting a primary trait and incompatible/required traits, prevents self-referential rules, and disables creation until at least two layers have traits.

existing_features.title: Rarity Workshop (weights init/normalize/locking/proportional redistribution)
existing_features.description: Auto-initializes missing/invalid weights, normalizes weights to sum to 100.00, supports locking traits, proportionally redistributes weights on slider updates, includes equalize/randomize actions, and shows expected counts plus rare (<1%) highlighting.

existing_features.title: Preview: weighted random mix with rule validation + canvas compositing
existing_features.description: Generates random trait selections based on weights, validates against rules with bounded attempts, and composites layers to a canvas using blend/opacity and optional pixel-art mode; uses square outputSize from settings.

existing_features.title: Forge: Genesis Craft (trait-by-trait selection) with live preview and mint-to-vault
existing_features.description: Allows selecting one trait per layer, renders a live composite preview, and mints the composite image into the project’s custom token library with an assigned token number.

existing_features.title: Forge: Direct Injection upload queue + batch commit
existing_features.description: Upload arbitrary images (png/jpeg/gif) into a queue, remove queued items, and commit them as custom tokens in one action; each is assigned a token number.

existing_features.title: Forged token library management
existing_features.description: Displays forged/custom tokens with thumbnails and type info; supports deleting a forged token and removing generated NFTs referencing it.

existing_features.title: Vault: worker-based collection generation with progress, batching, and cancel
existing_features.description: Starts a module Web Worker to generate NFTs, receives capability/progress/batch/complete messages, supports cancellation, and progressively commits batched results into project state (replace-only model clears previous results at start).

existing_features.title: Deterministic DNA generation and uniqueness enforcement
existing_features.description: Generates a deterministic DNA string from the ordered layer list and selected trait IDs; prevents duplicate DNA during generation and during per-item regeneration.

existing_features.title: Typed UI/worker generator protocol with capability detection
existing_features.description: Shared TypeScript protocol defines start/cancel inputs and capability/progress/batch/complete/cancelAck/error outputs with data structures for layers/traits/rules/forged tokens and runtime type guards.

existing_features.title: Vault: main-thread compositing fallback with UI yielding
existing_features.description: If the worker cannot composite images, the UI composites images on the main thread using selectedTraits and yields periodically to keep the UI responsive.

existing_features.title: Vault browsing: search, trait filters, sorting, view modes, and detail modal
existing_features.description: Browse generated NFTs with full-text search across id/name/attributes, multi-trait filters grouped by layer (and clear-all), sorting by index/rarity/commonness, compact vs grid view modes, and a detail modal with attribute quick-filters.

existing_features.title: Vault rarity analytics (frequency map, ranks, tiers)
existing_features.description: Computes trait frequencies from non-forged NFTs, derives rarity scores, ranks items, and assigns tiers (Legendary for forged, otherwise Epic/Ultra Rare/Rare/Uncommon/Common by percentile).

existing_features.title: Exports: single NFT assets, collection metadata JSON, and ZIP download
existing_features.description: Export a single NFT’s PNG + metadata JSON, export collection metadata JSON, and download a ZIP containing images/{id}.png, json/{id}.json, and _metadata.json created in-app.

existing_features.title: Low-memory (headless) mode during generation
existing_features.description: Optional low-memory mode hides the Vault grid while generating to reduce memory pressure; progress remains visible.

existing_features.title: Settings page: square output size + metadata/export configuration with live preview
existing_features.description: Configure square output size (outputSize), metadata format preset (Solana/Ethereum/ICP), token description, external URL template, IPFS gateway prefix, start-at-zero toggle, and royalties percent; shows a live metadata preview derived from settings.

existing_features.title: Settings UI simplification: remove project-level fields from Settings page
existing_features.description: Settings page no longer exposes project-level fields like Name, Symbol, Token count, Pixel art toggle, or Token name template; those are managed elsewhere (e.g., project dashboard).

existing_features.title: Metadata preset utilities with template placeholder resolution
existing_features.description: Utilities build metadata previews and per-NFT metadata using templates ({{collection}}, {{id}}), optional external_url, IPFS gateway prefixing, and format-specific fields (e.g., Solana seller_fee_basis_points/properties).

existing_features.title: Internet Identity authentication context (scaffolding)
existing_features.description: InternetIdentityProvider manages AuthClient initialization, optional stored-identity restoration, login/logout, and exposes status flags and identity to the app.

existing_features.title: Backend actor creation hook (scaffolding)
existing_features.description: React Query hook creates/caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor based on the current Internet Identity and invalidates/refetches dependent queries when identity changes.

existing_features.title: Motoko blob-storage authorization and maintenance mixin (backend library)
existing_features.description: Backend includes Motoko modules for authorized principal management, dead blob listing/pruning, and cashier cycle top-up endpoints via a mixin included in the main canister.

existing_features.title: No-backend query layer (placeholder)
existing_features.description: The app intentionally does not implement backend queries for core workflows; persistence and generation operate entirely client-side with localStorage.

existing_features.title: ICP build/deploy template (frontend+backend) scaffold
existing_features.description: Adds a reusable build-template workspace including frontend/backend canister configs, Dockerfile, deploy script, and utility scripts (e.g., prune/resize images) to package and deploy the Studio Art Engine stack.

existing_features.title: Pinata API key management with auto-validation (per project)
existing_features.description: Adds a per-project Pinata API key input and automatically validates/tests the key as the user enters it, providing clear success/error feedback and gating publishing actions on valid credentials.

existing_features.title: Lock collection gate for IPFS publishing + publishing state tracking
existing_features.description: Introduces an explicit “Lock collection” action that freezes the collection for publishing and gates all IPFS uploads behind this step; tracks and displays publishing state/progress in the UI.

existing_features.title: Pinata-only IPFS publishing pipeline (images + metadata) with CID injection
existing_features.description: Uploads generated images and metadata to Pinata/IPFS, captures returned CIDs, and injects finalized IPFS URIs into per-token metadata for downstream export workflows.

existing_features.title: One-click export with finalized IPFS URIs after publishing
existing_features.description: After publish completes, provides a single export action that outputs collection metadata with final IPFS links (and related export artifacts) suitable for immediate use in minting/deployment workflows.

existing_features.title: Non-technical Settings UX for Pinata-only publishing (mini guide + upload state)
existing_features.description: Simplifies Settings for the Pinata-only flow by removing gateway/endpoint/CID configuration, showing a short step-by-step guide, and displaying current publishing/upload status in a user-friendly way.

existing_features.title: Settings: Pinata JWT (secret access token) guidance with detailed step-by-step help
existing_features.description: Updates the Settings/Pinata credential UX to explicitly require a Pinata JWT (secret access token) and provides a more detailed explanation with a small step-by-step guide to reduce invalid-key confusion.

existing_features.title: Vault: always-visible collection publishing controls (Lock/Unlock/Upload) for clearer Pinata workflow
existing_features.description: Adds explicit, always-visible publish controls on the Vault page (Lock, Unlock, Upload) to surface the existing lock-gated Pinata publishing actions more clearly without changing underlying publishing behavior.

existing_features.title: Ethereum metadata export excludes Solana-only royalty fields
existing_features.description: When exporting/publishing with the Ethereum metadata format preset, Solana-only fields such as seller_fee_basis_points are omitted from the generated metadata output.

existing_features.title: Export target derived from Settings metadata format (project table blockchain removed) + ICP option shown as disabled
existing_features.description: The app no longer uses a project-table Blockchain field to determine export target; instead, blockchain/export behavior is derived from Settings → metadata format. ICP is displayed as a disabled “coming soon” option (visible but not selectable).

existing_features.title: Header project-name notification badge no longer causes layout shift
existing_features.description: Adjusts the header’s project-name notification/badge layout so it does not change the navigation bar’s width/position when appearing or updating, preventing visible jitter/shift.

existing_features.title: Vault publishing UI copy and success alert condensed for reduced vertical space
existing_features.description: Reduces the vertical space consumed by Vault publishing instructions and makes the green “Uploaded successfully!” alert more compact, while keeping concise explanatory copy for Lock/Unlock/Upload behaviors.

existing_features.title: Header SaveStatusIndicator placed to the right of project name without shifting navigation
synonyms: Stable header layout with save status
existing_features.description: Adjusts Header layout so the “Saving…” / “Saved” status indicator can appear to the right of the active project name without causing the navigation bar buttons to shift or move.

existing_features.title: Settings/Publishing note about Pinata free-plan suitability for collection size
existing_features.description: Adds a small Settings/Publishing guidance note warning that Pinata’s free plan is generally suitable only for small–medium collections and that large collections likely require upgrading to a paid plan.

existing_features.title: Apply a coherent Apple HIG–inspired visual theme across the entire app (translucent surfaces, calm contrast, premium typography hierarchy) while preserving the existing page/section layout structure (Dashboard, Workshop, Rarity, Rules, Preview, Forge, Vault, Settings).

Unify interaction feedback and motion system across the app using the existing motion tokens and easing (e.g., --motion-hover/press/component/modal and --ease-apple), ensuring consistent hover/press/focus/disabled/loading states for buttons, cards, nav items, dialogs, and toggles.

Standardize user-facing copy to a calm, premium, readable tone in English across the app (replace shouty ALL-CAPS toasts/labels/buttons with sentence case or title case as appropriate), without changing the underlying behavior.

Polish global navigation and header behavior for responsiveness and predictability: consistent active state styling, improved spacing/alignment, and mobile menu interactions that feel stable and premium.

Refine Workshop UI for calmer typography and improved affordances (layers list, drag/reorder, rename, trait cards, upload), preserving all current functionality and layout regions (sidebar + main panel).
Refine Preview page UI to match the global theme (preview frame, generate button, pixel mode toggle panel) and ensure button/toggle feedback feels immediate and consistent.
Refine Forge (Builder) page UI for consistent modal/panel surfaces, tab styling, selection states, and action feedback while preserving the existing Forge workflow and screen structure.

Refine Settings page layout polish (left form panel + right preview panel) to match the global theme, with improved spacing, consistent section styling, and predictable interactive states, without changing Settings functionality.

new_feature_requests.summary: For Solana projects, add Settings fields to capture creator wallet address(es) (and related creator metadata as needed) so exported/published Solana metadata includes the required creators information

App-wide UI/UX + logic optimization pass to ensure smooth/predictable/responsive behavior, remove broken/dead/inconsistent flows, simplify UI (minimal/redundant-free), improve spacing/typography/hierarchy, ensure responsive layout (desktop/tablet/mobile), add immediate visible feedback for actions, and unify motion system (Apple HIG-style) for a calm premium experience
Refine Dashboard UI for spacing, hierarchy, and interaction feedback (project cards, new project dialog, project settings dialog), keeping existing fields and flows intact.

Refine Vault UI for readability and reduced clutter (toolbar, filters sidebar, grid cards, detail modal, progress/loading areas), with consistent card styling, spacing, and feedback states across view modes and screen sizes.

architectural_notes: React SPA with view-state routing in App.tsx (dashboard/workshop/rarity/rules/preview/forge/vault/settings) and per-project state updates via functional updaters.

Central domain model defined in App.tsx (Project/Settings/Layer/Trait/Rule/CustomToken/GeneratedNFT) with runtime validation + sanitization and small migrations (legacy rule shape; legacy width/height -> outputSize).
Persistence is local-only: debounced autosave overwrites a single canonical localStorage key (last-write-wins) plus one-time cleanup of legacy temp/backup keys and near-quota warning utilities.
Collection generation is off-main-thread via a module Web Worker; UI/worker communication uses a shared typed protocol (message unions + type guards).
Worker supports capability detection for OffscreenCanvas/createImageBitmap compositing; UI has a main-thread compositing fallback (with yieldToUI) when worker compositing is unavailable.
Canvas compositing follows a consistent reverse-order draw convention so later layers visually render on top; supports pixel-art mode by disabling image smoothing.
UI built with TailwindCSS + shadcn-ui primitives; Sonner toasts for feedback; Lucide icons across the app; motion/animation tokens centralized in CSS/Tailwind config.
Destructive confirmations are centralized via a Zustand store + global AlertDialog with a Promise<boolean> confirm() API.

Metadata preview generation is encapsulated in a presets utility supporting template placeholders ({{collection}}, {{id}}), format-specific mapping (Solana/Ethereum/ICP), royalties conversion, and optional IPFS gateway/external URL templating.

Authentication/Backend scaffolding: InternetIdentityProvider (AuthClient) + React Query hook to create an authenticated/anonymous backend actor; backend includes a blob-storage authorization/cashier refill mixin.
known_issues: Trait-weighted selection logic in Preview/Vault/worker assumes weights effectively cover 0–100; if weights sum to <100 (or are all 0), selection can omit traits and reduce valid-generation success rate.
Renaming layers/traits after generation can break Vault rarity scoring and filtering because they map generated metadata attributes by layer/trait names (not stable IDs).

normalizeProjects() clears generatedNFTs from all projects except the most recently generated one when loading/saving, which can surprise users expecting multiple projects to retain their generated collections.

localStorage persistence stores images as base64 data URLs and can hit quota quickly; on quota failure autosave sets status=failed but the SaveStatusIndicator intentionally hides the failed state (error mainly visible in console).
Settings page keeps a localSettings state initialized only on mount; switching projects while Settings remains mounted can show stale values until remount.

Worker forged-token numbering ignores CustomToken.tokenNumber and assigns shuffled token IDs; if customTokens.length > collectionSize, forged IDs can become undefined and produce invalid NFTs/metadata.
Direct Injection upload validation is strict (png/jpeg/gif only), but Workshop trait upload accepts any image/*; behavior differs across upload entry points.
Export ZIP/PNG assumes generatedNFT.imageData is present and PNG; if imageData is missing/corrupted, export can fail (limited user-facing diagnostics beyond a toast).
